sources.title: Inheriting a Home Secured by an FHA-insured Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (fact sheet, 9/2019)
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development — Federal Housing Administration
sources.authorityNotes: HUD/FHA one-page consumer fact sheet, PDF cached and extracted to committed text (data/idaho/raw/extracted/ab3aff18d36501fd.txt, pdftotext -layout). Footer reads '9/2019'; publicationDate is taken from the file name (09-23-19). Still linked from HUD's HECM page on 2026-11-13. It is a summary, not a rule: it counts the 30 days from the borrower's death where 24 CFR 206.125(a)(2) counts from the date of the notice, and its 'Know Your Options' sentence is garbled in the PDF. The two-column layout interleaves sidebar text in the extraction, so one quote is joined with ellipses.
sources.stalenessRisk: HIGH — seven-year-old summary of rules HUD adjusts by Mortgagee Letter; treat every figure as HUD's 2019 description and confirm with the servicer.
